description: Find the highest risk-scored DeFi vaults, optionally filtered by asset, chain, or minimum TVL. Returns the top 10 audited vaults sorted by Philidor risk score (higher = lower assessed risk; scores are not a safety guarantee).

asset.description: Filter by asset symbol (e.g. USDC, WETH)

chain.description: Filter by chain name or slug (e.g. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana)

name: find_safest_vaults
